   - Fixed by properly separating numeric and categorical columns, keeping only common columns between train/test datasets, and applying one-hot encoding only to categorical variables
   - Cell 5: Updated deprecated `sparse=False` parameter to `sparse_output=False`

All 5 cells now run successfully without any crashes or errors.
